title: Live
description: Follow Twitch channels. While they are live, SupoClip records the stream and clips its best moments. Clips appear in your Library about 15 minutes after they happen.
channelPlaceholder: Twitch channel name, twitch.tv link or YouTube link
empty: No channels yet. Follow a Twitch channel to start clipping its lives.
chatFilterOn: Only stretches where chat spikes are clipped. Turn it off for talk streams with a quiet chat.
chatFilterOff: Every stretch of the live is clipped. This uses much more processing.
removeConfirm: Stop following {channel}? Clips already made stay in your Library.
unavailable: Live clipping isn't enabled on this server.
signInBody: Sign in to follow live channels.
minScoreHint: Clips with a final score below this are dropped.
chatWeightHint: Final score = {ai}% AI score + {chat}% chat heat.

posting.title: Auto-posting
posting.description: High-scoring live clips go to the Postiz accounts you authorize here. No other account receives posts.
posting.notConfigured: Postiz isn't configured on this server (POSTIZ_URL and POSTIZ_API_KEY in .env).
posting.noneAuthorized: No account authorized: nothing is posted.
posting.noneAvailable: No other TikTok, YouTube or Instagram account is connected in Postiz.
posting.revokeConfirm: Stop posting to {name}? Posts already made stay there.
posting.today: {posted} of {cap} posts in the last 24 h

problem.missing: This account no longer exists in Postiz. Nothing will be posted to it.
problem.changed: This account changed in Postiz (name or network). Nothing will be posted until you authorize it again.
problem.disabled: This account is disabled in Postiz. Nothing will be posted to it.

posting.notAllowed: This account can't use this server's Postiz (POSTIZ_ALLOWED_USER_IDS in .env).
posting.blurSensitiveHint: Blurs nudity and heavy gore in clips before posting to this account
posting.visibilityHint: A source channel set to Unlisted or Private still holds its clips back on this account.
posting.visibilityHintInstagram: A source channel set to Unlisted or Private sends its clips here as drafts in Postiz, since Instagram can't hide a post.
posting.safePostingHint: Waits {minutes} minutes between posts on this account so clips never go out in a burst
posting.safePostingOffBody: With safe posting on, this account waits {minutes} minutes between posts. That keeps several clips from going out at once, in a burst, which platforms treat as spam: the videos compete with each other so each reaches fewer people, and the account can get limited (on TikTok, posting can even be blocked for a while). With it off, clips go out as soon as they're ready.
posting.todayNoLimit: {posted} posts in the last 24 h, no daily limit

editKitHint: Look applied to this channel's next clips
blurSensitiveHint: Checks this channel's clips and blurs nudity and heavy gore before posting
postVisibilityHint: The more restrictive of this and each account's setting wins, so this can only hold clips back, never make them more public. Instagram can't hide a post, so its clips wait as drafts in Postiz.
limitWindowsHintOn: Each live window (about 20 min) goes through Whisper and Claude. The limit protects your subscription usage.
limitWindowsHintOff: No limit: the whole live is analysed, using more Claude and GPU.

trending.title: Trending channels
trending.notConfigured: Set up the Twitch API: put TWITCH_CLIENT_ID and TWITCH_CLIENT_SECRET in .env and restart the backend.
trending.atLimitBanner: You already monitor {limit} channels, the maximum. To add one from here, remove another from the channel list below (trash icon).

channelSafePostingOn: This channel's clips wait {minutes} minutes between each other on every account, on top of the account's own gap.
channelSafePostingOff: Off: this channel's clips only follow each account's gap.
